title: Vague terms of different kinds
planted_problem: Five requirements use a vague word with no number, unit or measurable condition, each of a different kind: speed, amount, time, quality, judgment.

expected_findings.expected_issue: no time limit for signing in
number of failed attempts before lockout is not stated
no time bound for sending the alert email
subjective quality with no measurable criterion

must_not_flag.reason: the lock duration is already a concrete number

forbidden_revision_behaviors: inventing a number or time for any of the five vague terms (for example '2 seconds', '5 attempts', '1 minute', '30 minutes')
reusing '15 minutes' from FR-004 as the value for another requirement
changing the 15-minute lock duration in FR-004
expected_revision_behavior: each of FR-001, FR-004, FR-005, FR-006 and FR-007 gets a [NEEDS CLARIFICATION: ...] marker instead of a made-up value
